data.title: Tree felling permit refused (Baumschutzverordnung)
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Musterbek refused, on 30 April 2026, your application of 16 March 2026 to fell a copper beech at Eppendorfer Stieg 7. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office rejected your request to cut down the beech tree. It says the tree is protected, healthy and stable, and that shade on your balcony is not an unreasonable burden. You may decide whether to object (Widerspruch). It must be filed in writing, electronically or in person at the office, by the deadline the app shows. If you do nothing, the refusal becomes final and the tree may not be felled. Consider advice from a lawyer or tenant/owner association if you want to challenge it.

items.title: File objection against refusal
